game.name: Liquid Space Dodger
game.desc: An endless dodger: slip through the gaps between the spikes that fall faster and faster. Four hits and it is over; your colour shows how much life you have left.

game.name: Virtua Worm
game.desc: Snake meets Pac-Man: guide the worm through 15 mazes and eat every pellet. Each one makes you longer, so do not run into yourself. Written in 68000 assembly.

game.name: Virtua Worm 2
game.desc: The sequel to Virtua Worm: new mazes to clear by eating every pellet without biting your own growing tail.
